messages:
From: Alex Hills <alex.hills@clearline.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: odd token-volume spikes observed — can we confirm if this was customer-facing?

Hi Logan,

We saw an unusual uptick in token usage from our integration between 06:10–06:40 UTC this morning. The calls look syntactically normal but volume is ~8x baseline and are concentrated from a small set of tenant IDs. No consumer PII observed in the sample, but we wanted to raise a quick flag while we investigate.

Could you confirm whether Redwood ran any remediation scripts, deployment rollouts, or testing jobs during that window? If not, we may need your help pulling a sanitized telemetry snippet and placing a legal hold while we check for exfiltration.

Appreciate a quick reply — we’ll pause any planned escalations for 24 hours if you can share preliminary context.

—Alex
Alex Hills
Security Ops | Clearline Financial

- Artifacts prepared: telemetry snippet (clearline_telemetry_snippet_20270308.txt) and full extract (telemetry_extract_2027-03-08.zip) — storing in secure bucket and creating an immutable snapshot for the legal hold.

Hi Alex — thanks for the sample, that helped. Quick operational notes and proposed plan for the walkthrough:

What we found (summary):
- The burst appears to be client-side automation hitting valid endpoints repeatedly (rate limits not exceeded on our side).
- No detected anomalies in request payloads beyond repeated prompt patterns; no PII in the sample.
- Caller IPs map to an automated runner triggered by a Clearline dev pipeline.

Proposed next steps (joint walkthrough):
1) 2027-03-09 17:00 UTC — 30 min call with Clearline SecOps + Redwood SOC + Legal. Karthik (SOC), Marissa (for logs), Naomi (legal), Logan (ops lead).
2) We will provide a redacted postmortem (IR_postmortem_redacted_v1.pdf) during the call and share a Drive link.
3) Redwood will set an evidence hold for 90 days. If legal deems it necessary, we’ll convert to a longer matter retention.

If that timing works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Thanks,
Karthik
